methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The Cost of Opportunity Analysis will reveal the financial losses generated by not implementing the already identified EPIAs

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Economic opportunity-cost ('Cost of Indecision') analysis of two unimplemented energy-efficiency measures (VSD pump replacement, heat recovery); ISO 50001/EnPIs cited only as context, and no EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued. Energy-savings figures are one-shot engineering inputs to an NPV/IRR/SPP/BCA financial model, not a performance-measurement baseline or indicator.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the Case Study of an industrial consumer which operates in the bricks manufacturing sub-sector will be presented
